# G&T Solutions

> G&T Solutions (Graphics & Trends Solutions) is a Noida-based turnkey office
> interior and fit-out company. Founded by Aman Garg, who has 10 years of
> individual experience in the fit-out industry, backed by a team with 20+
> years of combined experience. The company has delivered 500+ projects and
> over 30 lakh sq ft (3 million sq ft) of built space across 30 cities in 3
> countries.

## What we do
- Turnkey office interiors and fit-outs
- Workspace design and build
- Custom furniture, fabrication and installation
- Retail, hospitality and museum interiors

## Services
Detail and shop drawings, finish selection, material sourcing, civil work,
electrical, low voltage/IT, plumbing, fire systems, woodwork, furniture,
paint, ceilings and partitions, lighting, and signage — all delivered
in-house under one contract, from drawings to final finish.

## Where we work
Headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Active across 30 cities in
3 countries.

## Clients
TCS, Dabur, Hero Group, OYO, Levi's, Adani Infra, Jubilant FoodWorks,
Shapoorji Pallonji, Grant Thornton, Indian Railway, Indian Navy, and others.

## Notable projects
- TCS, multiple locations: 5,00,000 sq ft
- Lucknow: 2,00,000 sq ft
- Coimbatore: 50,000 sq ft
